claims.quote: Current records suggest it to be endemic to and occur throughout the Western Ghats mountains, southern India, with records from both east and west-flowing river systems including the Sharavathi and Bhagra rivers in Karnataka state, Chalakudy, Periyar and Bharathapuzha in Kerala state, and Cauvery and Tamiraparani in Tamil Nadu state.
